stall.agent.notRunning.note: The card's agent (or reviewer) has no session running.

stall.agent.removed.note: The card's agent (or reviewer) was removed from the project.

stall.agent.removedUnnamed.note: The card's agent was removed from the project, its name not kept.

stall.doing.noAgent.text: In Doing, but no agent has it.
stall.doing.noAgent.note: A card in Doing that no agent has (#170).

stall.doing.startFailed.note: HI-1976: the card's agent couldn't be started. why: the failure, in Combwork's or the CLI's own words.

stall.doing.startWaiting.note: HI-2304: the card's agent can't start in its slot yet. why: what holds the slot, in English ("slot-a is held by WindowsSandboxServer, left running by MB1's last run").

stall.duration.hours.note: A stall's duration in whole hours: "2 h".

stall.duration.hoursMinutes.note: A stall's duration over an hour: "5 h 5 min".

stall.duration.minutes.note: A stall's duration under an hour: "40 min".

stall.forward.waits.text: A forward merge the merge queue returned ({from} into {to}): no agent works on it, so it waits for the user or the Assistant: {removeOnly, select, yes {it went against the release path's direction, so only Remove from queue ends it.} other {Retry merge, Resolve on a builder (a card for a builder to resolve it) or Remove from queue.}}
stall.forward.waits.note: HI-2959: the stalled reason of a forward merge card (Combwork's own card bringing branch {to} up to date with {from}) that came back from the merge queue. removeOnly yes: it was refused for the release path's direction (HI-2892). Retry merge, Resolve on a builder and Remove from queue are the window's commands.

stall.lane.orderWait.text: {reviewer} is waiting for {other}, before {card} in the lane, while {builder} waits on the review of {card}: each has waited on the other for {waited}.
stall.lane.orderWait.note: A lane deadlocked: its reviewer waits for a card before this one in the lane, while its builder waits for this card's verdict. waited: a duration (stall.duration.*).

stall.laneNext.depsDone.text: {card} is the lane's next card: the last of the cards it depends on went Done {minutes} min ago, and {doing}
stall.laneNext.depsDone.note: The Agent API's and lane watches' stalled (HI-2618): a lane's next card whose dependencies are all Done, not started since. card: its key; minutes: how long since the last of them went Done; doing: what its builder does, a sentence ("B1 is only watching without starting it.").

stall.loop.designWait.text: {builder} posted a design on {card} for its reviewer to check and has waited {waited}: nobody has answered it, and it hasn't gone ahead as posted (cw_loop_step proceed).
stall.loop.designWait.note: #1382: the builder posted a design for its reviewer to check before building; nobody answered, and it didn't go ahead once its wait was over. waited: a duration (stall.duration.*).

stall.loop.followUpWait.text: {builder} posted a follow-up on {card} for its reviewer to check and has waited {waited}: nobody has answered it (cw_loop_step ok or gaps).
stall.loop.followUpWait.note: #1467: the builder posted a follow-up for its reviewer to check, and nobody answered. waited: a duration (stall.duration.*).

stall.loop.notWatching.text: {agent} isn't watching {card}: its turn ended with no card watch.
stall.loop.notWatching.note: #376: the agent looping on the card ended its turn with no card watch, so nothing wakes it.

stall.loop.wakeUntaken.text: {agent} hasn't taken the wake Combwork typed for {card}: it waits in its prompt.
stall.loop.wakeUntaken.note: #777: the agent watched the card, and its wake waits untaken in its prompt (its CLI didn't take the line).

stall.review.given.text: {card} was given to {agent} to review {given} ago, and it hasn't started reviewing it{state, select, busy { (it is working on something else)} other {}}: in Review for {waited}.
stall.review.given.note: HI-2636: a card waiting in Review that Combwork's reviewer pool gave to a reviewer, which hasn't started its review (watching it or not). given: how long ago it was given; waited: how long it has been in Review (both durations, stall.duration.*). state: busy (working on something else) or none.

stall.review.noVerdict.text: {agent} started reviewing {card} but has given no verdict, and has only been watching it for {waited}.
stall.review.noVerdict.note: A card in Review: its reviewer started the review, then went back to watching without a verdict. waited: a duration (stall.duration.*).

stall.review.wait.text: {agent} is watching {card} but hasn't started reviewing it{state, select, silent { (it shows working, but has been silent for {silentMinutes} min: state unknown)} busy { (it is working on something else)} other {}}: in Review for {waited}.
stall.review.wait.note: A card waiting in Review: its reviewer watches it but hasn't started. state: silent (it shows working, but has said nothing for silentMinutes), busy (working on something else) or none. waited: a duration (stall.duration.*).

stall.safeguard.stopped.text: {agent}'s latest turn was stopped by {provider}'s safety filter at {time} ({stops, plural, one {# stop} other {# stops}} this session). Look at its pane before nudging it, and tell the user.
stall.safeguard.stopped.note: HI-2754: said after a stall's reason when the agent it is about is idle and its latest turn was stopped by its CLI's safety filter. agent: its name; provider: the coding agent's name (Codex); time: "18:54"; stops: how many this launch.
